title: Hilbert transforms on graph products of finite von Neumann algebras
summary: We study Hilbert transforms on graph products of finite von Neumann algebras, with particular interests on their boundedness on the associated noncommutative $L_p$-spaces for $1<p<\infty$. We establish a generalized Cotlar identity for Hilbert transforms, valid on operators whose lengths exceed a constant depending only on the underlying graph.
